_comment: BTF Wiki for Pterodactyl; import this file via Nests -> Import Egg.
name: BTF Wiki (Fumadocs)
author: BTF-SCPSL
description: Run the prebuilt BTF Wiki (Next.js + Fumadocs) from GHCR. No npm install at startup; SERVER_PORT is used automatically. Content updates require rebuilding the image.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
mkdir -p /mnt/server
echo 'BTF Wiki is packaged in the Docker image; nothing to download.'

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Timezone for logging and date formatting.
